SELECT t.ID, t.FACTORY_CODE, t.YEAR, t.MONTH, t.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, t.PRODUCTION_VERSION, t.PLAN_TYPE, t.DATA_SOURCE, t.CX_MACHINE_CODE, t.STRUCTURE_NAME, t.IS_HAS_SPECIAL_MATERIAL, t.MAX_EMBRYO_CODE_COUNT, t.MAX_LH_MACHINE_COUNT, t.MIN_LH_MACHINE_COUNT, t.NET_QTY, t.LOSS_QTY, t.BEGIN_DAY, t.END_DAY, t.ALLOT_DAYS, mm.CX_MACHINE_TYPE_CODE, 1 data_type, max(md.STRUCTURE_TYPE ) STRUCTURE_TYPE, sum(md.TOTAL_QTY ) TOTAL_QTY, sum(md.DIFFERENCE_QTY ) DIFFERENCE_QTY, max(md.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE) PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, max(md.PRO_SIZE) PRO_SIZE FROM T_MP_STRUCTURE_ALLOCATION t LEFT JOIN t_mdm_molding_machine mm ON t.CX_MACHINE_CODE = mm.CX_MACHINE_CODE AND mm.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT JOIN T_MP_MOULDING_DAY_RESULT md ON md.STRUCTURE_NAME = t.STRUCTURE_NAME AND md.PRODUCTION_VERSION = t.PRODUCTION_VERSION AND md.FACTORY_CODE = t.FACTORY_CODE and md.year = t.year and md.month = t.month and md.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = t.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION AND md.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE t.factory_code = #{factoryCode} AND t.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} AND t.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion} AND t.YEAR = #{year} AND t.MONTH = #{month} AND t.IS_DELETE = 0
AND t.CX_MACHINE_CODE LIKE concat('%', #{cxMachineCode}, '%')
GROUP BY t.ID, t.FACTORY_CODE, t.YEAR, t.MONTH, t.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, t.PRODUCTION_VERSION, t.PLAN_TYPE, t.DATA_SOURCE, t.CX_MACHINE_CODE, t.STRUCTURE_NAME, t.IS_HAS_SPECIAL_MATERIAL, t.MAX_EMBRYO_CODE_COUNT, t.MAX_LH_MACHINE_COUNT, t.MIN_LH_MACHINE_COUNT, t.NET_QTY, t.LOSS_QTY, t.BEGIN_DAY, t.END_DAY, t.ALLOT_DAYS, mm.CX_MACHINE_TYPE_CODE ORDER BY t.CX_MACHINE_CODE, t.BEGIN_DAY
